abstract: The Food, Pharmaceutical & Bioengineering (FP&BE) Division Student Workshop will feature speakers representing all areas of FP&BE, including food, pharmaceuticals, bioengineering, and investigation of fundamental questions in life sciences using the tools and principles of engineering. Researchers from each area will present a short series of talks to give students an overview of current and emerging research directions in FP&BE. Speakers will also lead panel discussions on a variety of topics including graduate school, job tracks in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and food, and how to get involved with FP&BE at AIChE. Following the presentations, speakers will be available for a casual networking “meet and greet” with students.
